subject.title: [Feature]: Fallback approval mode + model attribution in messages

question: Should OpenClaw core add a default-off per-agent approval gate before automatic model fallback, and what approval delivery, timeout, and fail/proceed behavior should it use?
rationale: The missing behavior adds provider-routing config and interrupts the current reliability fallback loop, so automation cannot safely choose the product contract.

options.title: Design Core Approval Gate
options.body: Add a default-off per-agent fallback approval policy after specifying channel delivery, timeout, fail/proceed behavior, docs, and regression coverage.

options.title: Keep Automatic Fallback
options.body: Reject pre-fallback approval and rely on responsePrefix/model visibility plus logging or notifications for transparency.

options.title: Defer To External Orchestration
options.body: Leave the fallback loop unchanged and document that users needing approval before provider changes should orchestrate model selection outside core.

recommendation.title: Design Core Approval Gate
recommendation.body: Add a default-off per-agent fallback approval policy after specifying channel delivery, timeout, fail/proceed behavior, docs, and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans agent model config and fallback policy, where steipete has the strongest current history among the likely owners.
